I told Marcus in a thread reply on his #north-team message that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 27 January.

- **Where it came from:** On 14 Oct Dana posted 7 July in #north-team. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random to 27 January, saying she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in both channels, so he could see both messages himself.
- **Not checked against a contract:** I found no Brackenwater account files in the share, so I suggested he confirm the date with Dana.
- **Who owns the account:** A September 2025 note says Brackenwater moved to Marcus on 15 Sept 2025. Dana's messages suggest she may be handling it now, but I didn't bring this up.
